description: This file contains static functions for printing test results in different formats (CLAP and TAP) for the clar testing framework. It includes functions for initializing, shutting down, reporting errors, and indicating test and suite progress, with support for different verbosity levels and output formats.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_init
methods.description: Prints initialization message for CLAP format, indicating loaded test suites.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_shutdown
methods.description: Prints shutdown message for CLAP format, reports all.

methods.name: clar_print_indented
methods.description: Prints a string with indentation, handling newlines.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_error
methods.description: Reports a test failure with details.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_ontest
methods.description: Reports individual test result in CLAP format.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_onsuite
methods.description: Indicates start of a test suite in CLAP format.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_onabort
methods.description: Handles aborts in CLAP format.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_init
methods.description: Prints TAP format initialization.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_shutdown
methods.description: Prints TAP format shutdown.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_error
methods.description: Handles TAP format errors (empty implementation).

methods.name: print_escaped
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in strings for TAP output.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_ontest
methods.description: Reports individual test result in TAP format, including detailed error info if failed.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_onsuite
methods.description: Indicates start of a test suite in TAP format.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_onabort
methods.description: Handles aborts in TAP format.

methods.name: clar_print_init
methods.description: Dispatches initialization printing based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_shutdown
methods.description: Dispatches shutdown printing based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_error
methods.description: Dispatches error reporting based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_ontest
methods.description: Dispatches individual test result reporting based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_onsuite
methods.description: Dispatches suite start reporting based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_onabortv
methods.description: Dispatches abort handling based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_onabort
methods.description: Variadic wrapper for abort handling.
